description: Frozen 3327-video KuaiRec catalog with public captions/categories. content_types accepts video; put topics or interests in query. Search returns BM25-ranked lexical matches using terms in the visible titles, captions or categories. A multi-character Chinese segment must share at least one adjacent character pair; only a query consisting of one Chinese character can match that single character. Space-separated terms and pairs use OR admission, so long phrases need not match in full. BM25 scores retain the original unigram/bigram tokens. Empty or unmatched queries return no items. Popularity retrieval is not available in this benchmark. Scores are source signals, not individual relevance probabilities. duration_ms is a public big-table content measurement. Per-user unknown entries are ineligible. Retrieve up to 100 distinct candidates and recommend up to 10 distinct items; do not invent entries to fill an undersized result. limit is the number requested from this retrieval, from 1 to 100; it is separate from the final recommendation count.
